rationale: Build on the current winner without reopening weaker architecture branches. The recent EMA wins imply the exact score is now limited more by late noise in float-kept tensors than by the remaining int8 matrices, so intermediate quant-aware snaps should keep targeting the tensors that will actually quantize while leaving float-kept tensors on the smoother training manifold until the final export cast. This compounds the best float-kept EMA path, removes a redundant pre-save roundtrip when EMA will overwrite it anyway, keeps shapes and artifact format stable, and directly aims at lower final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact val_bpb under the same 600-second budget.
title: Quantized-Only Tail Snaps With Float-Kept EMA
